visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Outdoors on a paved area bordering a lawn, a young girl with pigtails in a green striped t-shirt holds a red bean wheel cake. A woman's hand is visible occasionally. The background shows lush green vegetation under natural daylight. (2) A large cast-iron wok is shown close-up, filled with seasoned glutinous rice being stirred with a metal spatula. Nearby, stainless steel bowls contain various fillings: chunks of braised pork, bright orange salted egg yolks, and diced bamboo shoots. (3) An older girl in a pink checkered dress assists in making zongzi by scooping rice into a bamboo leaf cone held by an adult. The setting is a rustic outdoor kitchen area with wooden tables and multiple metal containers of ingredients. (4) Transitioning indoors to a living room, the younger girl is fed a piece of bamboo shoot at a wooden table. She makes a pained facial expression, indicating the food is peppery. The background includes a television and home furniture. (5) The two girls sit at a small green children's table. The older girl uses training chopsticks to feed the younger one bits of a cooked zongzi from a tan bowl. The younger girl eventually eats a very large mouthful and walks away happily.
